name: Wand and finite battery
description: The wand has a limited energy-storage/supply role; crafting and firing selected spells draw from a finite source.

invariants.cast_transfer: At admission, debit the caster and credit one independent cast once. Disconnecting the source does not reclaim transferred mana.
invariants.physical_energy: Storage and energy flow must be legible; the wand may combine caster and reservoir in one object.

traits.compatibility.verification: Unverified; pinned inputs identify what must be checked together.
traits.open.capacity: Exact capacity, units, thresholds and tariffs remain open.
traits.open.refill: Replace, refill or externally feed: mechanism and rate remain open; no free automatic refill.
traits.source.contract: SPELL_STRUCTURE.md, finite caster-to-instance transfer settled from user clarifications.

notes: Design decision is separate from task completion, asset selection and implementation evidence. Reference images are on the off-path design-review board; no selected image anchor is asserted.
